text: DSH Git Branch Switcher（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在会话头部显示当前 Git 工作区分支，并可从界面切换分支。它把 Git 状态与操作接入会话级远程服务，在会话标题工具区展示分支胶囊。用户可查看本地分支、识别当前分支，选择分支后执行切换；遇到 detached HEAD 时显示短提交标识。适合在多个项目分支间切换、希望从 DSH 会话界面管理当前工作区的用户。需要工作区为 Git 仓库，并通过 DSH shell 服务调用 git；不需要 API 密钥或额外账号。

DSH Git Branch Switcher (DSH Web plugin): shows the current Git branch in a session header pill. Open it to browse local branches and check one out. It reads the session workspace and labels detached HEAD. Requires a Git workspace and uses DSH shell to run git; no API key or account is required.
想在 DSH 网页会话里直接看当前项目切到了哪个 Git 分支。
有没有办法从会话标题里的按钮选择另一个本地分支并切过去？
I want to check and change the Git branch for my current DSH workspace from the session UI.
DSH Git Branch Switcher 的功能「会话分支胶囊」：在 Git 工作区会话的标题工具区显示当前分支；打开面板可查看本地分支并点击切换，切换后会刷新状态。
DSH Git Branch Switcher 的功能「分支状态提示」：会话界面定期读取当前分支，支持 detached HEAD 时显示短提交标识；无法识别为 Git 仓库时不显示分支控件。

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · English：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin: a Git branch pill in the session header that shows the current branch of the session's workspace and lets you switch branches straight from the UI.

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · Features：- Shows the current git branch in the top-right session header (only for git-managed workspaces)
- Click the pill to open the branch panel: local branches, current one highlighted with ✓
- Click any branch to `git checkout` it; the pill updates immediately
- Detached HEAD support: shows the short commit hash with an explanation
- Auto-refresh every 30s (picks up terminal-side switches) plus a manual refresh button
- Checkout failures (e.g. conflicting local changes) surface git's own error message
- Theme-aware: all colors use the shell's `--dsw-*` tokens, light/dark ready
- Sandbox-aware: git runs under the same sandbox policy as the session's shell

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher#main"
```

Then restart your Web profile:

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

The plugin is now listed under Settings → Plugins and the branch pill appears in the session header.

Alternative (source checkout):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher
dsh web --patch ./dsh-git-branch-switcher/cordis.patch.yml
```

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · Usage：1. Open a session whose workspace is a git repository.
2. The branch pill appears at the top-right of the conversation header.
3. Click it → branch list → click a branch to switch.
4. The ↻ button re-reads the branch list.

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · Architecture：| Half | File | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | `gitBranch` Typert Remote service (`status` / `branches` / `checkout`) running git through the `shell` service with the session's sandbox policy. Plain-JS Remote markers, no generated artifacts (SRC mode). |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Prebuilt `__ModuleLoader__` bundle mounting the Remote contribution and rendering the header pill (session-scoped `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot). |
| Patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the dual-face plugin row into the Web profile. |

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · Dynamic plugin variant：`dynamic/` contains the same feature as an in-session dynamic Cordis Plugin (the form the DSH Web UI's plugin authoring flow runs). See `dynamic/README.md`.
@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · 简体中文：一个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 插件：在会话头部显示当前项目所在 git 分支的胶囊按钮，点击即可在界面里直接切换分支。

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · 功能：- 在会话头部右上角显示当前 git 分支（仅当项目由 git 管理时出现）
- 点击胶囊弹出分支面板：本地分支列表，当前分支以 ✓ 高亮
- 点击任意分支即执行 `git checkout` 切换，胶囊立即更新
- 支持 detached HEAD：显示短提交哈希并给出说明
- 每 30 秒自动刷新（终端里切了分支也能同步）+ 面板内手动刷新按钮
- 切换失败（例如本地有冲突改动）时显示 git 原始报错
- 颜色全部使用主题 `--dsw-*` token，自动适配亮/暗主题
- 尊重沙箱策略：git 命令与会话 shell 使用同一套沙箱策略执行

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher#main"
```

然后重启 Web profile：

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

插件会出现在「设置 → 插件」中，分支胶囊显示在会话头部。

源码方式（patch 覆盖层）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher
dsh web --patch ./dsh-git-branch-switcher/cordis.patch.yml
```

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · 使用：1. 打开一个工作区为 git 仓库的会话。
2. 会话头部右上角出现分支胶囊。
3. 点击胶囊 → 分支列表 → 点击分支即可切换。
4. ↻ 按钮重新读取分支列表。

@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · 架构：| 半边 | 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | `gitBranch` Typert Remote 服务（`status` / `branches` / `checkout`），通过 `shell` 服务执行 git，沿用会话沙箱策略。纯 JS Remote 标记，无生成产物（SRC 模式）。 |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | 预构建 `__ModuleLoader__` bundle：挂载 Remote 贡献并渲染头部胶囊（会话级 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 插槽）。 |
| Patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | 将双面插件行插入 Web profile。 |
@mixin-ai/dsh-git-branch-switcher README · 动态插件版本：`dynamic/` 目录提供同功能的内存态动态 Cordis 插件源码（DSH Web UI 插件创作流程所用的形态），见 `dynamic/README.md`。
